text:
anya: Proposal: run a 6-partner Private/Dedicated beta that’s explicitly ROI-focused. We’ll measure not just technical gates but partner business impact (latency -> conversions, cost per inference). Intent: validate our selling points for enterprise GTM.

olivia: Nice angle. That means intake needs revenue/metric fields so partners can tie results to KPIs. Also need clear consent to link anonymized usage to a short business outcomes survey.

raj: Ops note: adding business metrics increases scope for CS and product. Keep the survey lightweight: 3 metrics max. Also, how will we handle partners that can’t share revenue numbers? we need fallbacks.

maria: Fallback: allow qualitative tagging (improved UX, faster page loads, internal SLA wins). Still valuable. For the intake, add fields: priority KPI, estimate of baseline metric, desired lift.

sam: For compensation, propose two tracks: (A) credits + 10 hrs eng support OR (B) enhanced on-prem assist (up to 24 eng-hours) for high-impact partners. Keep legal-simple SOW addendum.

anya: Data & privacy: require an opt-in for linking anonymized telemetry to the business outcomes survey. Legal to provide a short addendum: telemetry retention 90 days, no PII, aggregated reporting only.

legal: We'll draft a 2-paragraph addendum and a checkbox wording. Also require partners to attest they own the business metric data they share. No direct revenue sharing or revenue data storage beyond aggregate numbers.

olivia: Suggested intake snippet (short):
```
Company:
Preferred deployment: VPC / on-prem
Primary KPI (e.g., checkout conversion %):
Baseline value:
Target lift (%):
Willing to link anonymized usage -> KPI survey? Y/N
Prefer compensation: Credits / Eng-hours
POC (name/email):
```
I’ll wire this to the CS shortlist flow.

raj: Success criteria (combine technical + business):
- Technical: onboarding SLA met for 4/6 partners AND 95th pctl latency within SLO for 2 weeks
- Business: for 3 partners who supplied KPIs, at least one shows measurable improvement in the target metric OR all report qualitative positive impact (>=7/10)
- Process: intake -> handshake -> preflight pipeline completes within 10 business days for first wave
If both Technical + (Business OR Process) pass, we consider pilot a go for GA readiness.

maria: Feedback cadence: weekly 30-min eng sync + fortnightly business outcomes review w/ partner exec. Use a shared sheet and tag follow-up items as GitHub issues.

cs-bot: cs-bot: Shortlist exported (10 candidates). Recommending initial outreach to top 8, include KPI ask in outreach.

anya: Next steps: (1) legal provides addendum checkbox copy by 1778000800, (2) olivia publishes intake + KPI field wiring by 1778000600, (3) raj to prototype brief preflight that outputs a simple pass/fail + remediation checklist by 1778001200, (4) sam drafts compensation options & simple SOW language by 1778001000. I’ll coordinate the initial outreach after the intake is live. :rocket:
